name: 三列で組む施設ギャラリー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0034 三列で組む施設ギャラリー. MINIMAL FRAME/CAPTION EDIT around protected photographs; do not create new photography. ORIGINAL priority: input1 exact original gallery region is authoritative for all four photos, crops, geometry, optical detail, column proportions and spacing. Input2 native mock secondary Japanese-caption/layout guide. Inputs3/4 exact original left/right media crops provide fine photographic detail. Input5 approved bus is STYLE ONLY. All original photographs must remain identical compositions, people, statue, buildings, leaves, sky and crops, with only uniform resampling; no generative redraw.
Keep three-column mosaic: narrow left tall photograph of dusk TENNIS COURT with purple sky; center wider column with top square STATUE photograph and bottom square CITY/PARK photograph stacked, separated by a small white gap; right tall TREE-FRAMED LAWN photograph with people and a dog. Relative widths and original crops exactly as supplied; do not expand the already cropped outside edges. Rounded corners, purewhite#FFFFFF canvas and gaps, very fine neutral outline, restrained depth. Modest white outer margin, no giant container padding. Preserve photographs, not a recreated park.
Replace ONLY caption-overlay areas in left/right photos. Left exact Japanese caption "テニスコート" (the native芝生の広場 incorrectly labels the visible tennis court). Right exact "眺めのよい公園". Use compact opaque WHITE rounded caption panels with ink#1D1D1D and fine neutral edge, near bottom of each tall tile, with small consistent inset; cover the old English quote/avatar text regions completely using caption panels, not new scenery. Source partial English cannot be reconstructed, so do not invent missing words. Native lower edge leaves English fragments visible; remove those text/avatar remnants by the white caption panel extending to that lower overlay region. Do not alter uncovered photograph pixels or invent people/faces.
Accent decision: photo colors are original imagery; retain them. Existing broad darkgreen mock caption blocks are arbitrary decoration, so replace with white caption panels. No green/mint overlay, tinted media, random colored icons or new CTA. Locked Meiryo captionRegular40014/24,tracking0, exact Japanese wording, natural wrap if needed. No extra heading, count, arrows, buttons, nav, logos or device. High-resolution flat frontal single gallery component matching source approximately1.23:1 width-to-height with small white margins. This is source-media-preserving UI edit; photo fidelity has priority over beautification.
reviewNotes: All four original photo/crop regions inspected. Candidate has correct three-column mosaic and Japanese captions, but quote/avatar regions were replaced with fabricated park/court scenery above small bottom captions instead of opaque caption panels covering those regions. Source photography also appears resynthesized in fine details; exact media preservation unproven. Captions overbold. Needs targeted caption-only edit preserving original photo pixels, not completed visual acceptance.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
